request.text: A remote service appears to have launched an Empire agent on WORKSTATION6. Contain host WORKSTATION6.theshire.local.

package.rationale: pgustavo connected to WORKSTATION6 from 172.18.39.5 and opened the svcctl pipe to control services remotely; a SYSTEM PowerShell then ran whoami and beaconed to 10.10.10.5:80. This is remote service execution over SMB (SMBExec) planting an agent on WORKSTATION6; isolate the host now.

permitted.note: rule A rule 2: WORKSTATION6.theshire.local is the request's host; policy P2-tier12-isolate; fulfils the request

rule A rule 2: powershell.exe (PID 1152) acts on WORKSTATION6.theshire.local and is part of the attack (the Empire agent started by the remote service, beaconing to 10.10.10.5:80); policy P6-irreversible-tier2; does not fulfil the request (side action)

rule A rule 2: whoami.exe (PID 8752) acts on WORKSTATION6.theshire.local and is part of the attack (discovery run by the agent); policy P6-irreversible-tier2; does not fulfil the request (side action)

rule A rule 2: cmd.exe (PID 4716) acts on WORKSTATION6.theshire.local and is part of the attack (the service command that launched the agent); policy P6-irreversible-tier2; does not fulfil the request (side action)
rule A rule 2: cmd.exe (PID 6040) acts on WORKSTATION6.theshire.local and is part of the attack (start /b of the agent); policy P6-irreversible-tier2; does not fulfil the request (side action)
rule A rule 2: pgustavo acts on WORKSTATION6.theshire.local and ran the attack; policy P4-human-account; does not fulfil the request (side action)
